Senior Media Buyer (Meta Paid Social) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Media Buyer to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll own the full lifecycle of Facebook and Instagram (Meta) advertising campaigns—from campaign planning and creative strategy to optimization and scaling. You’ll collaborate with clients and internal teams to improve campaign performance, lower acquisition costs, and maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, enjoy testing new ideas, and thrive on delivering measurable business results, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Strategy & Management

  • Build, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through execution.
  • Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring each campaign achieves performance goals.
  • Optimize:
    • Campaign structures
    • Audiences
    • Placements
    • Bidding strategies
    • Budgets
  • Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze key metrics including:
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Cost Per Click (CPC)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Test:
    • New audiences
    • Offers
    • Ad creatives
    • Landing pages
    • Campaign strategies
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.

Creative Strategy

  • Develop creative concepts, messaging, and campaign angles.
  • Write detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing advertisements.
  • Analyze creative performance and recommend ongoing testing opportunities.

Client Communication & Reporting

  • Present campaign performance updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Recommend strategies to scale successful campaigns and improve underperforming accounts.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

Growth & Innovation

  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and results.
  • Test new automation tools, optimization techniques, and advertising strategies.
  • Contribute ideas that improve agency performance and client outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently meet or exceed performance goals.
  • Advertising budgets scale profitably while maintaining strong ROAS.
  • Acquisition costs decrease through continuous optimization.
  • Clients receive strategic recommendations backed by data.
  • Creative testing drives measurable campaign improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and long-term retention remain high.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine creativity with strong analytical thinking.
  • You enjoy testing, learning, and optimizing campaigns.
  • You can confidently manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions.
  • You communicate campaign performance clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where ownership matters.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing $10,000+ per month in advertising spend.
  • Experience managing five or more client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Meta Business Manager
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion API (CAPI)
    • Event Tracking
  • Experience optimizing campaigns for:
    • Lead Generation
    • Customer Acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make optimization decisions.
  • Experience developing creative strategies and writing detailed creative briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Experience working in a digital marketing agency.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Landing Page Optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance and creative workflows.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

Tech Stack

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Meta Business Manager
  • Meta Pixel
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Close CRM
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Workspace
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign performance dashboards.
  • Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion metrics.
  • Optimize audiences, creatives, placements, and bidding strategies.
  • Develop creative concepts and collaborate with designers.
  • Meet with clients to discuss campaign performance and recommendations.
  • Launch new campaigns and A/B tests.
  • Analyze results and implement optimization strategies.
  • Stay informed on Meta platform updates and emerging advertising trends.

In short: You’ll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of Meta advertising campaigns, helping clients achieve measurable business growth through data-driven paid social marketing.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  • Conversion Rate.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Campaign scalability and profitability.
  • Creative testing performance.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Lead high-impact Meta advertising campaigns for multiple client accounts.
  • Collaborate with clients and creative teams to deliver measurable business results.
  • Manage significant advertising budgets while driving continuous optimization.
  • Work with modern advertising tools and emerging AI technologies.
  • Fully remote work environment aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Career progression into:
    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and showcase your expertise in managing Meta advertising campaigns, optimizing performance, scaling ad spend, and improving ROAS across multiple client accounts. You’ll also be able to demonstrate your analytical approach, creative strategy experience, and how you’ve partnered with clients to deliver measurable marketing results.

Record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about paid social advertising, enjoy turning data into growth strategies, and thrive on scaling high-performing Meta campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help businesses achieve exceptional results through world-class performance marketing.

Remote Customer Service Team Lead

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To provide exceptional customer support on Sedgwick's primary temporary housing line while serving as a working team lead responsible for daily operational oversight, task delegation, workflow management, service level performance, and frontline leadership. This role supports policyholders, adjusters, hotels, and partners with housing-related inquiries while assisting with inbound calls, hotel bookings and extensions, billing-related questions, and administrative functions. The Team Lead acts as the primary decision-maker during assigned shifts, supports escalation management, monitors real-time volume, staffing coverage, customer service performance, and team participation, and leads by example by actively performing all customer service duties alongside the team to ensure accuracy, timeliness, quality service, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction across all housing operations.

Monitors dashboards to track call volume, email volume, queue activity, service-level performance, staffing availability, workload distribution, and operational metrics; identifies backlogs, bottlenecks, and coverage concerns and takes appropriate action to maintain service standards.

raw.description:
Remote AI Automation Consultant (Contract/Freelance)

3rd Wave | Remote | Project-based

About the role

3rd Wave is a UK-based AI automation consultancy. We design and build AI agents and workflow automation for SMBs, connecting the systems they already use so information moves between them without manual effort.

We're building a pool of remote consultants to help deliver our pipeline of client projects. Work is project-based, so you'll pick up engagements that fit your skills and availability rather than committing to a single long-term role.

What you'll be doing

Every project is different, but the shape is consistent: you'll be integrating business systems (CRMs, job boards, document tools, spreadsheets, communication platforms) via APIs and browser automation, building orchestrated workflows, and layering in AI where it adds real value, always with a clear audit trail and a human able to stay in control.

Typical work includes:

  • Building automated workflows that connect two or more business systems end to end

  • Designing data pipelines that pull from external sources (APIs, scrapers, browser automation) and land clean, structured data somewhere useful

  • Building AI-assisted steps into a workflow (extraction, classification, drafting, summarisation) with human review built in

  • Producing clear handover documentation so non-technical clients can run and maintain what you've built

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think than which specific tools you've used. The common thread across our work is systems integration and automation, so you should be someone who genuinely enjoys wiring disparate tools together and making messy manual processes disappear.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

  • Solid experience with a workflow automation platform (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) — n8n specifically is a big plus

  • Confidence working directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication flows

  • Experience with no-code/low-code data platforms such as Airtable, Clay, or

  • A working understanding of how to bring AI into a workflow sensibly: prompting, extracting structured output, and knowing when a human needs to check the result

  • How to create one shot prompts for agent prompts

  • Comfort with browser automation tools (e.g. Apify, Airtop, or similar) for the sites and services that don't offer a clean API

  • Good diagnostic instincts — able to trace a broken pipeline back to its root cause rather than just patching symptoms

  • Clear written communication, since you'll often be producing documentation a non-technical client relies on

You don't need to tick every box above. We'd rather hear from someone with deep strength in a few of these than a shallow pass through all of them.

How we work

  • All projects are scoped in a detailed Statement of Work before work begins, so you'll always know the deliverables, timeline and assumptions upfront

  • Projects typically run 2 to 6 weeks, though some clients have longer multi-phase programmes

  • Remote and asynchronous by default, with discovery workshops and check-ins as needed

  • You'll usually be working directly with the client's team during discovery and testing phases, not just building in isolation

To apply

Tell us about a system integration or automation project you're proud of, what tools you used, and what made it hard.

raw.description:
Position Summary

Freberg Environmental is seeking a Transportation Renewal Underwriter / Account Executive to join our Transportation team. This role is responsible for underwriting and managing an established transportation renewal portfolio, maintaining strong broker relationships, and supporting profitable growth across the book of business. The ideal candidate has commercial transportation underwriting experience, thrives in a collaborative environment, and enjoys building long-term partnerships with wholesale brokers.

This position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced transportation underwriters and program managers while developing a clear path toward future leadership opportunities within the underwriting organization.

Location: Denver, CO or Chicago, IL preferred. Open to remote candidates for the right individual. Denver-based employees will participate in a light hybrid schedule.

What will your job entail?

Key Responsibilities

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Underwrite and manage a transportation-focused renewal portfolio, balancing profitability, retention, and service objectives.

  • Review and evaluate renewals, endorsements, loss history, operational exposures, and account performance to determine appropriate coverage terms and pricing.

  • Analyze commercial transportation risks, including trucking, fleet, and commercial auto exposures.

  • Manage a small assigned book of business while supporting broader portfolio initiatives.

  • Maintain underwriting discipline and consistently apply carrier guidelines and authority levels.

  • Identify opportunities to improve account profitability, retention, and premium growth.

Broker Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with wholesale broker partners and select retail agencies.

  • Serve as a trusted underwriting resource by providing responsive service and coverage guidance.

  • Negotiate renewal terms, conditions, and pricing while maintaining strong distribution partner relationships.

  • Collaborate with brokers to retain profitable business and identify opportunities for growth within existing accounts.

  • Deliver a high level of service throughout the renewal and endorsement process.

Team Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Program Managers, senior underwriters, and cross-functional teams to support portfolio performance and client satisfaction.

  • Work collaboratively across the organization to identify cross-selling opportunities and strategic solutions for brokers and insureds.

  • Contribute to a positive, team-oriented culture by sharing knowledge, market insights, and best practices.

  • Support organizational growth initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

Compliance & Operations

  • Ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines, carrier requirements, regulatory standards, and company policies.

  • Maintain accurate underwriting documentation, account records, and file management.

  • Utilize underwriting systems and technology platforms to efficiently manage workflows and underwriting activity.

  • Assist with endorsement processing and policy maintenance activities as needed.

  • Monitor portfolio trends and renewal performance to support business planning and decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of commercial insurance underwriting experience, including at least 3 years focused on transportation, trucking, or commercial auto risks.
  • Experience underwriting renewal business, evaluating transportation exposures, and managing broker relationships within wholesale distribution channels.
  • Knowledge of commercial transportation risks, including non-admitted commercial auto, fleet, trucking, hazmat, and other specialized transportation exposures.
  • Strong underwriting, risk assessment, analytical, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance profitability, retention, and growth objectives.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and negotiation skills with a proven ability to work effectively with brokers, carriers, and internal business partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative, team-focused environment.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn underwriting, policy administration, and CRM platforms.
  • Property & Casualty License required or ability to obtain within 45 days of hire

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business, Finance, Insurance, or a related field

  • Familiarity with transportation-focused markets such as Northland, Nationwide, Carolina Casualty, Canal, or similar transportation underwriting environments.

  • Experience using Salesforce, Policy Decisions, or comparable underwriting and policy administration systems.

  • CPCU, ARM, AU, or other industry designations.

  • Existing relationships within the transportation insurance marketplace.

Training & Development

Freberg Environmental is committed to investing in the success of new team members. During onboarding, the selected candidate will travel to Denver for in-person training and mentorship with senior transportation underwriters. This hands-on experience is designed to accelerate product knowledge, underwriting expertise, and integration into the team.

Career Growth Opportunity

This role offers a defined path for advancement within the Transportation Practice. Successful candidates will have opportunities to expand underwriting authority, take on greater portfolio responsibility, and progress into Lead Underwriter and Senior Underwriter positions as they demonstrate strong underwriting performance, relationship management skills, and business impact.

Why Join Freberg Environmental?

  • Join a highly collaborative team of transportation underwriting professionals.

  • Manage a stable, renewal-focused book with strong broker relationships.

  • Gain exposure to specialized transportation and commercial auto risks.

  • Work alongside experienced leaders who are committed to mentorship and development.

  • Build a long-term career within a growing and successful transportation underwriting platform.

Company: Gridlines

Gridlines is a rapidly growing financial modelling consultancy practice. We are transforming the world of financial modelling, helping our clients to make

complex financial decisions quickly and with confidence.

We love to work with exciting clients that are making a big impact on the world around us, helping to tackle some of the world's greatest challenges.

We plan to continue our rapid expansion and are looking for the brightest and best talent to join us on this journey.

Role:

We are seeking an experienced model audit professional that is passionate about financial modelling and driven by growth.

You will work with a team of modelling professionals to analyse and review complex financial models, ensuring they are robust and reliable

Requirements

Functions and responsibilities

Gridlines’ commercial director for LATAM is responsible for setting and achieving the organisation's revenue and profit targets within the region. He/she leads and manages the sales, marketing, and business development teams, ensuring they have the resources, training, and support they need to perform effectively. He/she also develops and maintains relationships with customers, partners, and key stakeholders, and negotiates contracts and agreements. Furthermore, he/she monitors and analyses market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities, providing information and recommendations to senior management and the board of directors.

Functions of the Commercial Director at the strategic level

At a strategic level, the commercial director makes decisions that directly impact the company's growth and positioning. These are their main responsibilities. functions :

  • Participation in the company's strategic decision-making.
  • Market analysis and identification of new business opportunities.
  • Development and implementation of long-term business strategies, creating annual action plans towards the defined objectives.
  • Participation in the preparation and control of the annual commercial budget, both for expenses and sales.
  • Participation in defining the product or service offering.

These strategic functions allow the commercial director to align the commercial area with the company's overall objectives.

Functions of the Commercial Director at the tactical level

At this level, the sales director translates strategies into concrete actions and ensures their proper execution. These are their responsibilities. Tactics further relevant :

  • Report of actions and results obtained.
  • Report (monthly or quarterly) to the general management on the evolution of the department, actions and results by alignment with the defined annual plan.
  • General supervision and proper management of the client portfolio and prospecting for new clients.
  • Negotiation of contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Formulation of short-term pricing and promotion policies, whether in the form of campaigns or special operations.
  • Monitoring short-term billing and collection, as well as potential issues related to non-payment or delay.
  • Coordination with other departments of the company.
  • Implementation of systems and tools to improve the efficiency and productivity of the sales department.

Functions of the Commercial Director at the operational level

Daily, the sales director plays a key role in operational supervision and support. These are their responsibilities. main ones :

  • Directly developing and maintaining relationships with key clients, ensuring their satisfaction, resolving short-term problems, expansion, and customer loyalty.
  • Detection and monitoring of business opportunities.
  • Monitoring and analysis of weekly business metrics and results.
  • Identification and management of short-term business risks.
  • Representing the company at relevant events and trade fairs.

These operational functions ensure the correct execution of business tasks and strengthen customer relationships.

Benefits

A competitive base salary with flexible working arrangements, including a mixture of office-based, working from home, and working on client sites.

Significant opportunities for professional growth and development as we expand.

Access to cutting-edge financial modelling tools and resources.

Collaborative and supportive team culture

Title: Marketing Manager
Location: Remote (US-Based Only)
Pay Rate: $25.00 / hour
Employment Type: Full-Time

Turn Authentic History and Epic Experiences into National Buzz

At US Ghost Adventures, we don’t do boring. We manage some of the most unique experiences, iconic historic properties, and lifestyle brands in the country—from operating famous haunted locations like the Lizzie Borden House to running nationwide ghost tours, pub crawls, e-commerce gear drops, and mobile app initiatives.

We’re a fast-growing, creative team that gives you real ownership over national media strategy, property launches, and campaign vision. If you love travel, pop culture, storytelling, and building authentic hype around unforgettable brands, this is where you take your career to the next level.

Your Role in the Story

As our Marketing Manager, you sit in the driver’s seat of our brand growth, revenue campaigns, and media presence. You’ll own digital marketing strategy across our multi-brand portfolio while stepping up as our go-to voice for press, media, and creators.

  • Drive Multi-Brand Strategy: Launch end-to-end campaigns across high-visibility brands, historic property activations, tour rollouts, e-commerce gear drops, and app initiatives.
  • Lead Digital Performance: Oversee paid ad strategy (Meta, TikTok, Google, Reddit) and partner with our SEO/content leads to keep our brands ranking #1.
  • Own Media Communications:​​​​​​​ Serve as our primary press contact, writing press releases, pitching journalists, handling media inquiries, and managing brand statements when news drops.
  • Mobilize Creators & Partners:​​​​​​​ Build relationships with travel influencers, content creators, and local tourism boards to run sponsored visits and cross-promotional campaigns.
  • Orchestrate Execution:​​​​​​​ Guide social media managers, creative leads, and VAs to ensure campaign assets land on schedule and hit target KPIs.

The Toolkit You Bring

You combine creative hustle and digital literacy with the drive to step up and lead a dynamic brand ecosystem.

  • Digital Growth Savvy:​​​​​​​ Hands-on familiarity with ad platforms (Meta, TikTok, Google), social trends, conversion funnels, and modern SEO basics.
  • Versatile Writing Skills:​​​​​​​ A natural storyteller who seamlessly shifts between drafting press releases, pitching journalists, and editing landing page copy.
  • Fearless Outreach: Zero hesitation picking up the phone or cold-pitching journalists, creators, and partners to secure earned media.

raw.title: Commercial Director (Volunteer)
raw.excerpt: Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK.
raw.description:
Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our servicesprimarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers,but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

We're looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial Commercial Director to lead the growth of Y4Y Trading.

This is a unique opportunity to build a social enterprise from the ground up—developing commercial ventures that create genuine social impact while generating sustainable income for a growing charity.

You'll have the freedom to shape strategy, launch new initiatives, and turn innovative ideas into thriving businesses. Working closely with the Y4Y Trading Board and the Charity Executive Board, you'll play a pivotal role in creating long-term financial sustainability for Youth4Youth.

If you're someone who enjoys building businesses, spotting opportunities, driving growth, and creating lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

As Commercial Director, you'll lead the development and growth of Y4Y Trading's commercial activities by:

  • Developing and launching ethical commercial ventures aligned with Youth4Youth's mission.

  • Driving revenue growth through e-commerce, digital sales, partnerships, and innovative business development.

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and transforming ideas into sustainable income streams.

  • Overseeing product development, pricing, merchandising, customer experience, and online trading.

  • Monitoring commercial performance through budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and financial planning.

  • Building strong relationships with suppliers, partners, sponsors, and key stakeholders.

  • Implementing effective systems, processes, and operational improvements to support growth.

  • Supporting young people by creating opportunities for them to gain experience and develop commercial and employability skills.

  • Ensuring all commercial activities operate to high legal, financial, and ethical standards.

Skills

We're seeking someone who combines commercial thinking with a passion for making a difference.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience launching, growing, or managing a commercial business or trading operation.

  • A strong background in e-commerce, online retail, digital sales, or commercial strategy.

  • Excellent commercial awareness with experience identifying and developing growth opportunities.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the confidence to work independently and take ownership.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to solving problems and delivering results.

  • Experience within a charity or social enterprise is welcomed but certainly not essential.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

raw.description:
The Process Engineer is responsible for the development and execution of process engineering activities related to water treatment systems within greenfield industrial projects.

The role supports all project phases (FEL 1, FEL 2, FEED, and EPC), ensuring that water and wastewater systems are properly defined, designed, and integrated into the overall process.

The Process Engineer contributes to delivering technically robust and cost-effective solutions, focusing on water balance, treatment technologies, and compliance with environmental and process requirements. The role requires strong coordination with multidisciplinary teams and active participation in both design and execution phases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of process design for water and wastewater systems across all project phases (FEL, FEED, EPC).
  • Identify raw water requirements and characterize process effluents in coordination with process teams and clients.
  • Select and evaluate appropriate water treatment technologies to meet process and discharge requirements.
  • Develop and validate water balances, process schemes, and system configurations.
  • Perform process calculations and simulations to support equipment selection and system design.
  • Size key equipment such as storage tanks, treatment units, and utility systems.
  • Prepare and review process deliverables including PFDs, P&IDs, process design specifications (PDS), and technical reports.
  • Support the evaluation of water reuse and recycling strategies to optimize water consumption.
  • Ensure alignment between process design, environmental regulations, and project requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal disciplines (mechanical, electrical, civil, automation) and external partners.
  • Support procurement activities through preparation of technical specifications and review of vendor documentation.
  • Contribute to commissioning, start-up, and troubleshooting activities when required.

Typical Activities

  • Preparation of process documentation (BFD, PFD, P&ID, process notes).
  • Development of water balances and treatment concepts for industrial facilities.
  • Equipment sizing and process calculations.
  • Process simulation and performance validation.
  • Evaluation of treatment technologies (filtration, biological, chemical treatment, reuse systems).
  • Participation in technical meetings with clients, partners, and suppliers.
  • Support to tender preparation (technical scope definition, cost inputs, technical clarifications).
  • Contribution to design reviews and multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Occasional support to site activities, commissioning, and performance troubleshooting.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proven experience in water treatment process engineering within industrial projects.
  • Experience in FEED and/or EPC project environments is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of water and wastewater treatment technologies.
  • Experience in preparation of process documentation (PFDs, P&IDs, technical reports).
  • Familiarity with process simulation tools and engineering calculations.
  • Experience working with international standards and environmental regulations is an advantage.
  • Exposure to project execution, commissioning, or site activities is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Structured and detail-oriented approach
  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Proactive mindset with focus on practical solutions and delivery

What is the value of the business opportunities/pipeline and any key clients he will support?

The Process Engineer will support a portfolio of strategic greenfield projects within Ecolab’s European pipeline, focused on complex industrial water treatment systems and process integration. The role will additionally support from time to time to GHT and TWM.

The Process Engineer plays a key role in ensuring that water systems are properly designed and integrated within complex industrial projects.

By contributing to the definition and execution of robust process solutions, the role supports:

  • Reliable and compliant water and wastewater treatment systems
  • Optimization of water consumption and reuse
  • Improved project delivery through strong technical foundations
  • Enhanced competitiveness of Ecolab’s engineering solutions

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Georgian-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Georgian Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $23 - $25 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.

  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.

  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.

  • Employee Referral Program.

  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.

  • Interpreter support.

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:

The Georgian Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Georgian and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.

  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGeorgian and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.

  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.

  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.

    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.

    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.

    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

  • Restricted brands:

    • Kaspersky products.

    • Huawei hardware.

  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.

  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.

  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.

  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.

  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.

  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Fourteen (14) days from the posting date of September 18, 2026.

  • Be familiar with all course material

  • Report back on student engagement as requested

Time Commitment:

  • Time commitment will vary based on number of students assigned and is expected to be heavier during the summer months (May - August)

Qualifications:

  • Strong passion for course related topics
  • Experience working with adolescents/teens ages 13-17 from diverse geographical and socio-economic backgrounds

Astrid is a gaming studio that brings together accomplished worldbuilders and game developers to create multiplayer creative experiences. Our first project is a cooperative open-world sim, designed to foster connection, problem-solving, and shared discovery. Players embark on a profound social experience in a richly imagined world shaped by dynamic systems, immersive storytelling, and community-driven play.

Our team spans the US, the UK, and beyond. We are taking a fully remote approach, but have regular in-person meetups to synchronise, huddle and build our culture.

Job Description

Astrid is seeking an experienced Senior Gameplay Engineer to join our small and thoughtful team as we push the boundaries in gaming and IP, offering fans new meaningful worlds and experiences.

We are looking for an individual with a passion for co-op games. You care deeply about characters, behaviours, and game AI — the kind that players feel rather than notice. You will be building character and NPC behaviours, iterating on cameras and controls, and making sure our game feels fun.

This is a remote position on a fully distributed team.

Who You Are

  • You are passionate about games and what they mean for our players
  • You are proactive and take initiative
  • You are a problem solver with a positive mindset who likes a challenge
  • You care about code quality and reducing technical debt
  • You consistently address issues as you encounter them
  • You like to experiment and innovate
  • You work well with others and communicate technical concepts clearly
  • You have a continuous improvement mindset

What You Will Do

  • Design and create AI behaviours in Unreal Engine using State Trees and Blackboards.
  • Build and iterate on Character, Camera & Controls.
  • Integrate AI with the rest of the game systems to create a fun, exciting living world.
  • Share knowledge, mentor, and support colleagues in your area of expertise
  • Champion engineering quality
  • Partner with engineers, designers and artists to deliver excellent player-facing features

Requirements

  • Proven experience developing AI behaviours in Unreal Engine
  • An interest in 3Cs (Character, Controls, Camera) and experience in a Third-Person game
  • Working knowledge of State Trees, Blackboards, Perception, and GAS.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Solid knowledge of C++
  • Experience identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks in UI and gameplay systems

Bonus Experience

  • Experience with Unreal Replication.
  • Background in co-op or multiplayer character systems (replication, prediction, lag compensation)
  • Exposure to AI-driven narrative or social simulation systems
  • Experience with systemic game design (emergent mechanics, simulation-driven worlds, sandbox titles)

Benefits

  • Great compensation package and equity
  • Private health insurance
  • Pension
  • Unlimited vacation days. We trust our team!

  • We are committed to continuing to expand our benefits and perks to support our team.

We're looking for a part time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered

Role & Responsibilities

  • Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.
  • Providing a range of evidenced based, professional crisis counselling services and personal support, employing de-escalation techniques and crisis intervention techniques
  • Assessing the caller's needs and triage for immediate safety or emergency medical attention of callers, or referrals to appropriate service referrals such as face-to-face crisis intervention, case management/advocacy services, individual therapy, or group services.
  • Maintaining accurate and detailed call reports on key issues and referrals actioned
  • Complying with responsibilities under the Data Protection Acts 1988, 2003 & 2018 (GDPR)
  • Supporting in the development of appropriate crisis management plans to support callers in crisis
  • Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed
  • Ensuring smooth and diligent handover process to next shift personnel
  • Dedicating entire shift to intellect tasks and responsibilities only
  • Conducting risk assessments, including lethality assessment for suicide cases

Requirements

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Can effectively communicate in their native language
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases) and
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk case

Plus Points if you:

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

FT Salary Remote ( East Coast)

Position Summary

The Key Account Manager, LMWF is responsible for developing and executing strategic account management initiatives that drive profitable growth, strengthen customer partnerships, and expand market presence across key customers and the LMWF business segments.

This role leads the development of long-term customer strategies, oversees commercial execution, and ensures alignment between customer needs and company objectives. The Key Account Manager, LMWF will partner closely with marketing, supply chain, technical, and leadership teams to maximize customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth.

The role also serves as a key leader in identifying new business opportunities, managing strategic negotiations, and driving commercial excellence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders including sales, operations, technical teams, customer service, and supply chain to deliver exceptional customer experience.
  • Drive achievement of annual sales targets, revenue growth, profitability, and customer retention objectives.
  • Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and targeted markets.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer insights to support strategic decision-making.
  • Ensure effective forecasting, pipeline management, and reporting of business performance metrics.
  • Support strategic supplier and principal relationships aligned with customer and business objectives.
  • Promote a customer-centric culture focused on responsiveness, innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Chemistry, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in sales, account management, or commercial leadership roles within the Lubricant and Metalworking Fluid markets.
  • Proven experience managing strategic or national accounts within distribution, specialty chemicals, manufacturing, consumer products, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex negotiations and deliver profitable business growth.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced and customer-focused environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems, forecasting tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.

Core Competencies

  • Commercial Leadership
  • Negotiation & Influencing

  • Business Development

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Market & Competitive Analysis

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Job Description

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This position is a remote opportunity in the Lingo Division. Lingo is a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers – such as glucose, ketones, and lactate – to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize, and democratize healthcare.

Lingo Sales Representative

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

The Lingo Division has an opportunity for a Sales Representative in the Dallas Area. Lingo is a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers – such as glucose, ketones, and lactate – to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize, and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.

The primary responsibility of this role is to drive sales by securing commitments for recommendations from Healthcare Professionals in various offices including Internal Medicine, Primary Care, Concierge Practices, Dieticians, Longevity/Functional Medicine Practices, and MedSpas. Typical call points within these offices include: Physicians, Nurses, Medical Assistants, Administration, and Nutrition Services. Responsible for creating and maintaining relationships within these offices to effectively elevate the importance of Lingo by identifying and providing win-win solutions for using Lingo products. In addition to obtaining commitments for recommendations, it is also vital in this role to hold customers accountable and ensure compliance.

What You’ll Work On

  • Execute sales initiatives designed to exceed established sales goals for Lingo

  • Work closely with Lingo Sales Leader and cross-functional / interdisciplinary teams to execute the sales direction

  • Identify customer needs and deliver on sales opportunities accordingly

  • Utilize Lingo promotional materials to targeted healthcare professionals

  • Prioritize the utilization of resources to drive return on investment

  • Plan and organize to maximize focus on top priorities

Territory

  • 5-10% overnight travel for Regional/National meetings and trainings

  • This position does not offer relocation. Local candidates only, please.

Key Competencies

  • Persistence

  • Persuasiveness

  • Strong initiative

  • Results-Oriented / Will to win

  • Strategic planning and execution

  • Identify and prioritize call points

  • Adaptability and coachability

  • Sales and learning agility

  • Integrity

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree required

  • 1-3 years of sales experience preferred

  • B2B, Cold-Calling, Outside selling experience

  • Experience building own book of business

  • Wearable, fitness, nutrition, and medical device knowledge is preferred but not required

  • Strong business acumen

Apply Now

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

Divisional Information

Medical Devices

General Medical Devices:

Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.

CRM

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.

Diabetes

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.

Vascular

Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease.

Neuromodulation

Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.

Structural Heart

Structural Heart Business Mission: why we exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

EP

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

HF

In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

Diagnostics

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Abbott Molecular is a leader in molecular diagnostics and the analysis of DNA, RNA, and proteins at the molecular level.

Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

Our rapid diagnostics solutions are helping address some of the world’s greatest healthcare challenges.

Nutrition

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, and Glucerna® – to help them get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest lives

At Liberty, our Personal Lines Auto Product team partners across the company to build and roll out auto insurance solutions that keep pace with what customers and agents need. We focus exclusively on auto, bringing deep expertise, data and analytics to deliver strong state-by-state results while modernizing how we price policies and the technology that supports them. Organized around four core areas—Delivery & Development, Underwriting Effectiveness, State Management, and Mobility Solutions—we work collaboratively to live our purpose: helping people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of personalauto insurance? Join our PersonalLines Auto Delivery team, where you'll play a key role in shaping and executing innovative pricingprograms that drive USRM's profit and growth goals. You'll take ownership of end-to-end rollouts for assigned states, ensuring compliance with regulations while collaborating closely with stakeholders like the Director of State Operations. With a focus on project management, you'll simplify complex concepts and conduct deep analyses to guide strategic decisions. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love creative problem-solving, this role offers a unique opportunity to develop your expertise in pricing and product ecosystems while fostering cross-functional partnerships. Together, we can transform the way auto insurance works!

Responsibilities:

  • Fully own and execute on assigned states' end-to-end rollout of the latest personal auto insurance pricing programs.
  • Gather and document product requirements, clearly communicate requirements to stakeholders, and ensure accurate implementation.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for the pricing program and assigned states, provide thoughtful recommendations that influence state decisions and help drive corporate strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams and manage moderate to high complexity projects.
  • Conduct complex analyses to drive and support business decisions; where necessary, conduct in depth research of competitor offerings and filings.

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Business Analysis Advisor, you will be within PNC’s Retail Bank Operations organization, supporting the Retail Lending Solutions and Mortgage Investor Operations group. This position is remote.

The scope of Retail Bank Operations is impressively broad and encompasses a wide range of critical functions. These include managing the cash needs for our branch and ATM networks, printing and mailing important bank documents, and handling both inbound and outbound collections for home lending, automobile, and card services. Additionally, Retail Bank Operations focuses on loan mitigation and investor operations, developing process improvement and automation opportunities, overseeing the daily processing of cash and check deposits, bill payments, and executes strategic quality management functions.

The Retail Lending Servicing, Mortgage Investor Operations team supports mortgage servicing investor operations across Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae, Ginnie Mae, private investor portfolios, and default cash, driving process improvement, operational effectiveness, reporting, controls, and business analysis initiatives. Successful candidates will bring experience in mortgage servicing, investor reporting, loan administration, business analysis, finance, accounting, or reconciliations, along with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and deliver reporting that supports strategic decision-making. Knowledge of the mortgage servicing lifecycle, including payment processing, escrow, loss mitigation, servicing transfers, MSP, default servicing, and investor reporting, is strongly preferred. This role requires collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and operations partners to deliver solutions and drive continuous improvement. In addition to the job description below, the ideal candidate will also have:

Freddie Mac Servicing and Default Cash Postings:

Ideal candidates will have experience supporting Freddie Mac mortgage servicing operations, including investor reporting, investor accounting, loan administration, servicing transfers, remittance processes, reconciliation activities, and the interpretation and application of Freddie Mac servicing requirements. Candidates should also have experience processing and reconciling investor funds, mortgage insurance claim proceeds, liquidation proceeds, recoveries, refunds, and other default-related cash activity. Experience researching and resolving discrepancies, identifying process improvement opportunities, conducting root cause analysis, and partnering with cross-functional operational teams to strengthen controls, improve efficiency, and enhance servicing performance is highly valued.

Fannie Mae/Ginne Mae Servicing :

Ideal candidates will possess knowledge of Fannie Mae & Ginnie Mae servicing practices and investor guidelines, including reporting, reconciliation, compliance monitoring, servicing oversight, and operational support activities. Candidates should also have experience driving process improvement initiatives, identifying operational efficiencies, enhancing controls, and implementing sustainable solutions. Successful candidates will be comfortable analyzing complex servicing requirements, translating business needs into actionable solutions, and partnering across multiple stakeholder groups.

Private Investor & Portfolio Servicing:

Ideal candidates will have experience supporting private investor and portfolio servicing operations, including investor reporting, investor accounting, loan administration, servicing transfers, remittance processes, reconciliation activities, and the interpretation and application of investor-specific servicing requirements. Candidates should also have experience reviewing, interpreting, and operationalizing private investor servicing agreements and related contractual requirements, ensuring servicing activities, reporting obligations, remittance practices, and control processes align with investor expectations and contractual commitments. Experience supporting investor-related financial and operational processes, researching and resolving discrepancies, identifying process improvement opportunities, conducting root cause analysis, strengthening operational controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to improve efficiency, consistency, compliance, and servicing performance is highly valued.This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

raw.description:
The role is about:

The Gateway Related Projects team is committed to designing, developing, and implementing payment solutions that guarantee stable and consistent payment processing. Our goal is to create successful products and establish a reputation as a dependable partner for our clients.

In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment where system performance, scalability, and 99.9% reliability are critical to our core transaction flow.

  • Location: Remote from Portugal or Poland (Contractor arrangement)
  • Reporting to: Technical Lead

What you will do:

  • Dual-Track Engineering: Support and extend the existing Perl-based payment gateway while simultaneously designing and building high-performance microservices in Python.
  • System Modernization: Architect and implement scalable, distributed Python services to replace legacy components, ensuring reliability under high-load production environments.
  • High-Stakes Integrations: Integrate and manage complex third-party APIs and external payment services, ensuring seamless transaction flows and robust error handling.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead code reviews, drive engineering best practices, and identify system bottlenecks to continuously improve performance and scalability.
  • Architecture & Deployment: Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and architect solutions using AWS services (Lambda, ECS, etc.).
  • Product-Focused Delivery: Go beyond the "how" of the code—bring a product mindset to understand the business logic, user impact, and the "why" behind every feature you build.
  • Production Ownership: Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in distributed systems, maintaining a "zero-downtime" mentality for our merchants.

What we need:

  • Python Mastery: 5+ years of backend engineering experience with deep Python expertise (FastAPI and AsyncIO preferred).
  • Polyglot Mindset (Perl): Experience with Perl is a major plus, but a genuine eagerness to learn and work within Perl production code is mandatory. We value engineers who can bridge the gap between legacy and modern systems.
  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven experience building and scaling microservices architectures and high-throughput systems (e.g., payments, trading, or real-time processing).
  • API & Reliability Guru: Deep understanding of integrating third-party APIs, specifically managing webhooks, callbacks, idempotency, and retry policies.
  • Cloud & Containers: Strong experience with Docker/Containerization and a solid grasp of AWS cloud infrastructure (Lambda, SQS/SNS, and cloud networking).
  • Engineering over "AI Vibe Coding": We value deep engineering logic over blind AI-generated snippets. You should be an advocate for clean, intentional code who can explain the reasoning behind every line you ship.
  • High-Load Architecture: Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Ownership & Mentorship: You have a track record of owning features from design to production and enjoy supporting/mentoring other engineers in the team.
  • English Proficiency: Strong English communication skills—both written and verbal—to collaborate effectively across our remote-first, multi-functional teams.

Hiring Process:

  • Step 1 – Thinking in Action (40 minutes) Your first conversation will be with our Talent Acquisition team. We'll explore your background, career journey, motivations, and overall fit for the role. As part of this discussion, you'll also complete a short technical screening that will be reviewed by our engineering team. This stage helps us understand both your experience and how you approach technical challenges.
  • Step 2 – Build in Production (60–90 minutes) Meet with the Team Lead and technical experts for a practical assessment. Depending on the role, this may involve a live coding exercise or a real-world scenario designed to evaluate your technical skills, problem-solving approach, and ability to work through challenges similar to those faced by our teams.
  • Step 3 – Final Interview (45 minutes) The final stage is a group interview with senior members of our Technology squad, which may include the CTO, CPO, and Team Lead. Together, we'll discuss team fit, collaboration style, expectations from both sides, and any remaining questions about the role, team, or technology domain. This is also an opportunity for you to learn more about our culture and ways of working.

The perks of being a payabl.er:

  • Grow with Us: Annual Learning Budget for professional development (eligible after probation)—because your growth is our growth.
  • Celebrate Together: We bring colleagues from all offices together for unforgettable company celebrations.
  • Global Collaboration & Events: Opportunities to participate in international company events and initiatives, connecting with colleagues from all regions and contributing to a truly global community

The contract set up type will be assessed subject to your location and discussed in the first interview with your Talent Acquisition Partner.

Join our team, and let's innovate, disrupt, and lead the future of payments. Together, we can make an impact that resonates. Welcome to the team!

raw.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Accounting & Financial Services | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive pipeline and revenue growth across accounting and financial services.

This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role that goes beyond traditional appointment setting. You’ll prospect for new business, execute multi-channel outreach, conduct discovery calls, present solutions, and close smaller deals independently.

The ideal candidate has experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or related professional services and understands how to communicate with SMB owners about their financial and operational challenges.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Identify and research prospective customers across target verticals, including:
    • Churches
    • E-commerce
    • Construction
    • Home services
    • Trucking
    • Real estate
  • Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, directories, and prospecting platforms
  • Identify decision-makers and relevant buying signals
  • Understand industry-specific pain points and tailor outreach accordingly
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of new prospects

Multi-Channel Outreach

  • Execute outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold email
    • Cold calling
    • LinkedIn
    • Social platforms
  • Personalize messaging based on prospect needs and industry
  • Engage prospects and move qualified leads into discovery conversations
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across multiple touchpoints
  • Support basic Facebook and Instagram campaigns to generate inbound opportunities

Discovery, Qualification & Closing

  • Conduct discovery calls using frameworks such as BANT or MEDDIC
  • Understand prospects’ accounting, bookkeeping, and financial-service needs
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, needs, budget, and buying intent
  • Present relevant service solutions
  • Conduct demos and walkthroughs using tools such as Digits
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Prepare proposals and move opportunities toward close
  • Independently close smaller deals
  • Coordinate with the service delivery team for smooth client onboarding

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Own opportunities from initial prospecting through close
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with active prospects
  • Track conversations, tasks, and deal stages accurately in the CRM
  • Keep pipeline data clean and current
  • Ensure opportunities do not stall due to missed follow-ups
  • Maintain clear visibility into next steps across every active deal

Reporting & Performance

  • Track:
    • Outreach activity
    • Response rates
    • Discovery calls
    • Qualified opportunities
    • Conversion rates
    • Deals closed
    • Revenue generated
    • Paid campaign performance
  • Maintain accurate CRM notes and reporting
  • Provide weekly performance insights and pipeline updates
  • Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and conversion

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Proven B2B sales experience, preferably selling:
    • Accounting services
    • Bookkeeping services
    • Financial services
    • Related professional services
  • Experience conducting discovery and qualification calls
  • Demonstrated ability to close deals independently
  • Experience managing opportunities across the full sales cycle
  • Strong outbound prospecting and lead-generation experience
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • Salesloft
    • Outreach
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work independently during U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to SMBs or service-based businesses
  • Understanding of accounting workflows and financial operations
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel
  • Experience using Digits
  • Experience supporting or running Facebook and Instagram campaigns
  • Experience selling into industries such as construction, real estate, e-commerce, trucking, or home services

Tools & Tech

HubSpot | Salesforce | Apollo | Salesloft | Outreach | LinkedIn Sales Navigator | GoHighLevel | Digits | Meta Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve sold accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or professional services before
  • You can confidently move from cold outreach to discovery to close
  • You understand that success is measured by pipeline and revenue, not just activity
  • You can speak credibly with business owners about operational and financial pain points
  • You’re comfortable balancing outbound prospecting with inbound opportunities
  • You follow up consistently and maintain an organized pipeline
  • You take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for direction

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by researching target accounts and building prospect lists before moving into cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

Throughout the day, you’ll conduct discovery calls, qualify prospects, demonstrate solutions, handle objections, prepare proposals, and move active opportunities toward close.

You’ll also maintain CRM records, follow up with prospects, review campaign performance, and coordinate successful new clients with the service delivery team.

In short: you own the sales process from prospecting through close and turn qualified opportunities into revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified opportunities generated
  • Deals closed
  • Revenue contribution
  • Lead → discovery call conversion
  • Discovery call → close conversion

  2. Your creation continues driving success once it is active in our business as usual campaigns.

Should your concepts pass these milestones at least twice within two months, then we will add you to our permanent roster of freelancers that we partner with regularly.
