Job Summary:

As Lead, Residential Solar Service Operations, you will play a key role in leading a team that oversees the performance, operations, and maintenance of our residential solar portfolio while managing strategic partner and contractor relationships. In this role, you will be responsible for facilitating the resolution of maintenance issues, managing service invoices and costs, validating system operation, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams, contractors, and customers. You will lead and develop a team of service partners to limit service tickets, resolve issues remotely, and resolve system issues efficiently, while communicating insights to partners to drive scalability, efficiency, and best-in-class service across a 500 MW+ residential solar business.

Primary Responsibilities:

Partner Management:

  • Manage ongoing relationships with IGS’s partners to ensure operational and financial success for both our partners and IGS Solar.

  • Coordinate with service providers and internal teams to resolve maintenance issues quickly and efficiently.

  • Foster strong relationships with service providers, ensuring alignment with company service standards and requirements.

  • Monitor contractor performance, compliance, and adherence to service level agreements, addressing any concerns proactively.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve contractor payment or remittance issues; review contractor expenses and approve invoices for payment, ensuring accuracy and alignment with budget expectations.

  • Work collaboratively to identify, research, and resolve partner issues swiftly and completely by leveraging an expert-level understanding of the business.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead the service team, including day-to-day management, training, and development of individual contributors.

  • Mentor and support the team, providing guidance and day-to-day leadership to ensure high-quality service execution.

  • Build and empower team members to grow in their careers and become more effective in the industry.

  • Create and modify user guides, job aids, and documentation for training purposes.

Program Expertise & Training:

  • Act as an Asset Management 360 platform expert, guiding new service partners through the onboarding process, ensuring clear understanding of IGS’s internal CRM, service requirements, and processes.

  • Create clear instructional materials and deliver ad hoc training sessions with existing partners to maintain alignment with requirements.

  • Assist service partners with education and training on IGS standards for solar installations & maintenance.

  • Coordinate with IT to identify and resolve platform issues efficiently with minimum interruption to business processes.

Operational Efficiency & Reporting:

  • Compile key reports and dashboards to gauge and grade partnerships across relevant metrics, such as first truck roll resolution rates, time to resolution, cost, and operational efficiency.

  • Lead analysis of reports on maintenance trends and service case resolutions to drive data-driven decision-making.

  • Collaborate with leadership to develop and refine workflows that enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

  • Ensure the team maintains detailed documentation related to site visits, maintenance requests, and service activities; audit documentation to ensure accurate recordkeeping and compliance with best practices.

  • Contribute to special projects and initiatives to support the continued growth and success of the Residential Solar business.

  • Coordinate with leadership to identify and mitigate areas of risk exposure.

Required Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with customers, contractors, and partners.

  • Demonstrates a drive for results, efficiency, and embraces the value of Continuous Improvement.

  • Ability to adapt, evolve, and thrive in an ever-changing environment.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and document management skills with an acute attention to detail.

  • Positive attitude, self-motivated, strong analytical skills, results oriented, driven.

  • Ability to navigate complex resolutions and master new technologies and platforms (e.g., IGS’s proprietary platform, partner portals, reporting portals, invoicing systems).

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally, internally and externally, to ensure seamless partner and customer experiences.

  • Ability to simultaneously manage dozens of service contractor partnerships, multiple projects, and competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic industry.

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • Advanced knowledge of the Operation and Maintenance of photovoltaic systems.

Minimum Education and Experience:

  • Degree in Business Administration, IT, Operations, Renewable Energy focused, or other applicable field of study a plus, but not required.

  • 2-4+ years of experience in the Solar or Energy industry.

  • Familiarity with multiple Residential Solar system architectures.

  • 3+ years of experience using Excel for analysis and as a tool to communicate complex data effectively.

  • NABCEP professional certification a plus.

  • Relevant manufacturer install certifications a plus.

  • Experience with Solar Shading tools such as Aurora/Solmetric Suneye preferred.

  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software a plus.

  • Intermediate skills in all MS Office Applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, SharePoint).

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis. Unfortunately, a current or future need for sponsorship is not supported or available for this position.

$67,150.00 - $107,440.00

This role is also eligible for an annual incentive plan based on company performance.

About the Role

We are a fast-growing food and beverage brand looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to take ownership of order fulfillment and customer operations. This role is ideal for someone who is highly reliable, proactive, and comfortable taking full ownership of operational tasks from start to finish — with the opportunity to expand into freight management and broader operational responsibilities over time.

Work Structure & Requirements

  • Location: Remote / Virtual
  • Schedule: Part-time (20+ hours per week)
  • Time Zone: PST business hours
  • Compensation: $10 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities

1. Order Fulfillment & Customer Operations

  • Own end-to-end order processing and fulfillment across retail and wholesale customers
  • Review orders for quantities, pricing, ship dates, delivery requirements, and other key details; verify against finished goods inventory to confirm sufficient stock and shelf life
  • Respond to orders across relevant systems (e.g., email and SPS Commerce) — confirming orders, requesting changes when needed, and generating Advance Ship Notices (ASNs)
  • Enter and maintain orders in internal systems, including assigning and tracking lot codes
  • Submit orders to warehouses for fulfillment
  • Monitor orders from receipt through delivery and proactively resolve issues
  • Reconcile BOLs against purchase orders when shipments are released; ensure correct lot codes and inventory are assigned to each shipment and troubleshoot discrepancies
  • Maintain organized records of orders, BOLs, shipment confirmations, and delivery documentation
  • Support retailer and customer requests related to orders, shipping, and documentation

2. Freight & Logistics Coordination

  • Book and coordinate freight, communicating with freight brokers and 3PL partners
  • Schedule pickup and delivery appointments
  • Track shipments and proactively flag delays, missed appointments, or delivery issues
  • Maintain shipment tracking and proof-of-delivery records
  • Help resolve freight claims, shortages, damages, or delivery discrepancies

3. Broader Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate finished-goods inventory records and help identify potential stock-outs or excess inventory
  • Support supply and demand planning using historical sales, retailer forecasts, and upcoming production requirements
  • Coordinate with 3PLs, warehouses, vendors, and other operational partners on open issues and inbound/outbound inventory movements
  • Maintain clear operational trackers, SOPs, and reporting across orders, inventory, freight, and outstanding issues

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 3+ years in CPG operations, supply chain, order management, logistics, or a related role; previous experience within food, beverage, grocery, or another physical CPG category is strongly preferred
  • Order Management: Hands-on experience processing purchase orders and coordinating fulfillment; experience working with 3PLs, warehouses, freight providers, distributors, and retailers
  • Inventory: Strong inventory management and reconciliation skills; experience reviewing BOLs, shipping documentation, and lot-level inventory
  • Systems: Experience working in SPS Commerce; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • Communication: Excellent written and spoken English
  • Profile: Exceptional attention to detail, highly reliable, organized, and responsive; able to manage time-sensitive operational issues and follow tasks through to completion; proactive in identifying discrepancies and escalating issues when required

raw.title: Recruiter
raw.excerpt: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.
raw.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Help us build the team that patients count on when they call for care.

As part of a team of recruiters at Hummingbird, you'll participate in full-cycle recruiting for Patient Access Specialists and Triage Nurses, the team members patients reach first for everyday needs like booking an appointment, requesting a refill, getting clinical advice, or getting help logging into their patient portal.

You'll work alongside other recruiters to manage a high volume of requisitions and candidates, using structured interview and selection practices to keep hiring consistent and moving quickly. You'll partner closely with hiring managers to clarify requirements, keep the process on track, and advise on best hiring practices. You'll bring a sharp eye for process improvements, volunteering where we could adapt our work. This is fast-moving work, and it suits people who can prioritize independently, adapt quickly as priorities shift, and keep things moving without waiting to be told what's next.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting for high-volume hiring, from intake through offer execution.

  • Partner with recruiting leadership and hiring managers to clarify role requirements, set process expectations, and keep hiring on track.

  • Apply structured interview and selection practices to ensure consistent, defensible hiring decisions across a high volume of candidates.

  • Coordinate sourcing efforts and manage candidate pipelines through the applicant tracking system.

  • Evaluate candidates against role requirements for Patient Access Specialist and Triage Nurse positions, including technical skills and behaviors.

  • Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the hiring process and recommend improvements to keep pace with volume.

  • Track requisition status and candidate progress, flagging risks to hiring timelines early.

  • Maintain clear documentation of hiring decisions and candidate communication throughout the process.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent internet service.

  • Work Type: Full-time

  • Compensation: Expected range is $70,000 - $92,000. New hires usually start between $70,000 and $85,000, depending on experience and internal equity.

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience across multiple roles or functions or equivalent experience in people-facing roles that require strong task management and tailored communication.

  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and structured interview and selection practices.

  • Experience partnering with hiring managers to clarify requirements and manage hiring timelines.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of requisitions and candidates at the same time.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain hiring decisions and next steps to stakeholders who weren't in the details.

  • Sound judgment in applying structured hiring practices consistently across roles.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for contact center or high-volume healthcare roles.

  • Experience navigating Workday ATS.

  • Experience contributing to improvements in recruiting processes, tools, or workflows.

  • Comfort working in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.

  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.


A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time. We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

The Hummingbird Approach
We value a team that brings diverse perspectives and experiences to the work we do. While there are many ways to do this, people who are successful at Hummingbird:

  • Lead with Respect by valuing kindness and working to actively foster an environment of inclusion and respect.
  • Embrace Growth and seek out learning and growth for themselves and support those around them in their growth journey. They bring curiosity and an openness to innovation to all their interactions.
  • Bring a Win Together mentality by approaching conflict directly, listening carefully, and seeking to understand. They problem-solve with the goal of finding successes, not trade-offs, for all involved.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Hummingbird Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We value the talents of individuals from all backgrounds and actively seek a diverse workforce.

Our mission is to provide a fair and inclusive recruitment process for everyone, and reasonable accommodations are available to any applicant who may need them. Please reach out to to request accommodations and we’d be happy to chat.

Sr. Manager, Provider Operations Strategy & Programs

Remote | Full-Time, Salary, Exempt | Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

About the Role

Provider Operations keeps Steno’s nationwide network of court reporters running — coverage, quality, retention, and growth. This role exists to ensure we are staying coordinated across our team and with cross functional partners. You will own cross-functional program management, operational excellence, and strategic planning for the Provider Operations organization. You’ll identify and drive 3–5 high-impact initiatives per quarter, codify processes so they scale without scaling headcount, and ensure all pillar leaders (Quality of Service, Staffing, Experience, Growth, Analytics, Strategy & Programs) move in concert. This is a newly created role to help promote a clear line of sight for clients, and to find efficiencies in our cross-functional processes and workflows, but without impacting our clients' experience.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Provider Operations, you’ll manage a small team of project managers and act as a strategic partner to pillar leaders.

Who We’re Looking For

Someone with deep operational and program management experience who can operate effectively without positional authority. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, naturally connect cross-functional work, and know how to balance documentation with flexibility. You move fast, you’re data-informed, and you ship. Equally important: you understand the operational reality well enough that your plans are grounded and executable, not theoretical. You’re trusted with ambiguous, high-stakes problems and expect to exercise business judgment on trade-offs that affect fill rate, cost, and team capability.

On a Regular Basis, You Will

  • Partner with the Sr. Director to define and prioritize quarterly initiatives that span multiple pillars or require cross-functional coordination, developing comprehensive program briefs with scope, stakeholders, timeline, resource needs, success metrics, and dependencies
  • Drive programs from initiation to close-out, tracking progress against milestones, escalating blockers early, and measuring outcomes—both quantitative (fill rate impact, cost savings, cycle time) and qualitative (process improvement, team alignment)
  • Work with pillar leaders to document how core functions actually operate and design systems and tooling that scale processes without scaling headcount — playbooks, checklists, SLAs, decision trees that a new team member can execute on day one
  • Audit for gaps, redundancies, and hand-off friction; recommend changes and track implementation
  • Act as the connective lens across Quality of Service, Staffing, Experience, Growth, Analytics, Strategy & Programs — collecting signals from each pillar and flagging conflicts or opportunities early
  • Manage relationships between Provider Ops and cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support), proactively communicating constraints and capacity
  • Run quarterly planning sessions with pillar leaders to align on roadmap and surface risks and dependencies
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of what’s coming in the next 8 weeks that could surprise the business, including market shifts and product changes that affect provider strategy
  • Manage project managers, developing their scope and mentoring them into more complex projects
  • Evaluate automation and AI tools with pillar leaders, knowing where technology truly changes the economics versus where it adds unnecessary complexity

You’ll Thrive in This Role If

  • You’ve successfully managed 3+ concurrent programs across multiple teams without formal authority over those teams; you’re comfortable with ambiguity and track dependencies naturally
  • You’ve built or substantially improved a repeatable process that scaled with the business; you understand how to balance documentation with flexibility and standardization with local adaptation
  • You operate effectively without positional authority and can present trade-offs to senior leadership, influencing decisions even when stakeholders disagree
  • You’re data fluent with the ability to self-serve data to identify problems, track progress, and make trade-off calls
  • You ship — you set realistic plans, track against them, course-correct when needed, and avoid both paralysis by analysis and skipping necessary planning
  • You have experience at a high-growth company, especially in supply-side, logistics, or marketplace operations where you’ve seen how ops scales
  • You’ve managed one or more direct reports and developed them into independent operators
  • You communicate clearly and present ideas to senior leadership without jargon; clear communication signals you actually understand something
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and have made progress in environments where the mandate was clear but the path wasn’t

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in operations, business operations, or program management—or equivalent leadership impact in a relevant domain
  • Demonstrated track record of managing cross-functional work without positional authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort with ambiguity and high-stakes decision-making with incomplete information

Nice to Have

  • Supply-side ops, provider/marketplace operations, or recruiting/staffing supply chain experience
  • Work in regulated industries or organizations with complex external stakeholder management (e.g., gig economy, healthcare staffing, field services)
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing new tools or automation technologies
  • Facilitation or workshop design skills — you’ve led strategic planning sessions or cross-team retrospectives

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $135,000-$165,000
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous company-sponsored health plans for both employees and dependents, including comprehensive vision & dental
  • Wellness/Mental Health — shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off — allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity — we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
  • Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.
  • Applicants should receive a confirmation email immediately after applying. If you haven’t received it, check your email spam folder and approve the sender address to ensure receipt of future communications.
  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
  • Steno uses AI-assisted tools for this role to identify and prioritize candidates whose experience aligns with the role. All hiring decisions are made by our People team.

Job Title: E-Commerce Recruiter

Job Type: Full-Time Contractor

Workplace: Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. business hours (PST preferred)

Compensation: USD (DOE)

About HireHawk

At HireHawk, we connect top global talent with high-performing U.S. companies. Our focus is on finding exceptional professionals who bring both expertise and drive to every role. We’re passionate about helping candidates grow their careers while supporting our clients with reliable, remote-ready talent that makes an impact from day one.

About the Job

We’re looking for an experienced E-commerce Recruiter with a proven track record of sourcing and hiring talent for digital commerce businesses in the U.S.
This role requires a strong understanding of the e-commerce ecosystem, including commercial, marketing, operations, and technical roles. You’ll own the full recruitment lifecycle—from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer closure—while partnering closely with clients to ensure successful, business-aligned hires.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and excel at identifying and engaging top e-commerce talent, this role is for you.

Core Responsibilities

  • Source, screen, and recruit e-commerce professionals for U.S.-based companies.
  • Manage the full-cycle recruiting process, from job intake and candidate outreach to interview coordination and offer negotiation.
  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, and other sourcing platforms.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies tailored to different e-commerce roles (e.g., Digital Marketing, Performance, Operations, Product, Tech, Customer Experience).
  • Conduct structured interviews to assess technical skills, cultural fit, and commercial mindset.
  • Partner with the People & Compliance team to ensure smooth onboarding and documentation.
  • Track recruitment metrics and provide regular updates on hiring progress and pipeline health.
  • Stay up to date on e-commerce hiring trends, in-demand roles, and compensation benchmarks.

Requirements

Must-Haves for the Role

  • 3–5 years of experience recruiting e-commerce or digital business roles for U.S.-based companies.
  • Strong knowledge of e-commerce-related positions such as E-commerce Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Performance Marketer, CRM Specialist, Marketplace Manager, UX/UI, Product, or Operations roles.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple requisitions and clients simultaneously.
  • Hands-on experience with ATS platforms (Workable preferred) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with candidates and stakeholders.
  • Fluency in English (bilingual English/Spanish is a plus).
  • Availability to work full-time aligned with U.S. business hours (PST overlap required).

Nice-to-Haves for the Role

  • Experience recruiting remote e-commerce talent in LATAM or the Philippines.
  • Familiarity with independent contractor hiring models and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with DTC brands, marketplaces (Amazon, Shopify, Walmart), or omnichannel businesses.
  • Background in staffing agencies, startups, or high-growth companies.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive monthly compensation in USD (DOE).
  • Access to a $200k+ perk marketplace with instant discounts on 150+ services.
  • Access up to 50% of approved earnings before payday (no credit checks or fees).
  • On-time, in-currency pay.

Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.

Sales Executive III | Global Trip Support

Location: Houston/Webster, TX (Remote)

About World Fuel

World Fuel is a global leader in aviation fuel, trip support, and business aviation services. We help flight departments, aircraft operators, and aviation professionals operate more efficiently through reliable fuel supply, innovative technology, operational support, and industry-leading customer service.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and relationship-driven Sales Executive III to join our Global Trip Support team. This role is responsible for developing, retaining, and expanding relationships with high-value business aviation customers while driving revenue growth across World Fuel's global portfolio of aviation services.

This is a senior-level sales position focused on consultative selling, strategic account management, and complex customer relationships. The successful candidate will leverage deep industry expertise and an established professional network to acquire new customers, strengthen existing partnerships, and position World Fuel as a trusted advisor across all aspects of flight operations.

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned aviation sales professional who understands the business aviation ecosystem, has extensive trip support experience, and thrives in a highly customer-centric environment.

What You'll Do

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire new high-value Global Trip Support customers.
  • Manage and grow a portfolio of existing accounts while identifying opportunities to expand customer spend across World Fuel's aviation solutions.
  • Prospect and cultivate new business opportunities through industry relationships, referrals, conferences, networking, market intelligence, and targeted outreach.
  • Promote and sell Global Trip Support, Regional Trip Support, Online Flight Planning, Aviation Insurance, Fuel Programs, and other value-added aviation services.
  • Drive revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling initiatives across multiple product lines.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through contract execution and ongoing account development.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with flight departments, aircraft operators, directors of aviation, chief pilots, dispatchers, schedulers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic customer accounts and act as a trusted advisor on operational solutions.
  • Lead customer meetings, business reviews, and account planning discussions designed to strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Proactively identify customer needs, operational challenges, and opportunities to improve service delivery and account growth.
  • Support customer retention through exceptional service, issue resolution, account health reviews, and ongoing engagement activities.
  • Monitor changes in customer operations, fleet composition, or business circumstances that may impact account growth or retention.

Commercial Strategy

  • Analyze customer trends, business opportunities, industry developments, and competitive market conditions to support account growth strategies.
  • Develop pricing recommendations and support commercial negotiations aligned with company objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to maximize customer value while increasing account profitability and long-term retention.
  • Support contract renewals, strategic growth initiatives, and customer expansion efforts.
  • Collaborate with leadership on market development strategies within the business aviation sector.

Collaboration & Operational Support

  • Partner closely with Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Supply, and Trip Support teams to ensure exceptional customer experiences.
  • Facilitate customer onboarding activities, account setup requirements, customer preferences documentation, and billing coordination.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline activity, forecasts, and account plans within CRM systems.
  • Support international sales teams and collaborate across regions to maximize customer opportunities.
  • Travel as needed to support customer meetings, industry conferences, business development activities, and team initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of sales, business development, or account management experience within business aviation, trip support, or aviation services.
  • Proven success acquiring and retaining high-value aviation customers.
  • Extensive experience selling Global Trip Support or related aviation operational services.
  • Demonstrated ability to build long-term customer relationships and influence key decision makers.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation, presentation, and consultative sales skills.
  • Experience managing complex customer accounts and achieving aggressive revenue objectives.
  • Strong understanding of business aviation operations and customer buying behaviors.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling Global Trip Support, Regional Trip Support, Flight Planning, Aviation Insurance, Fuel Programs, or related aviation solutions.
  • Established industry network within business aviation and flight department communities.
  • Knowledge of international flight operations and trip support requirements.
  • Experience negotiating commercial agreements and managing strategic customer portfolios.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • Deep expertise in the business aviation and trip support industry.
  • An established reputation for building strong customer loyalty and trusted partnerships.
  • A consultative approach focused on solving customer challenges and creating long-term value.
  • The ability to identify opportunities across multiple aviation services and strategically expand customer relationships.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills.
  • A proactive, self-driven mindset with a passion for customer success and business growth.
  • The ability to navigate complex customer organizations while influencing key stakeholders and decision makers.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and commercially minded Contract Specialist to support project budgets, as well as the preparation, review, negotiation, and execution of a variety of client contracts within the pharmaceutical and CRO industry. This role partners closely with Legal, Finance, Strategic Pricing and Proposals, Sales, Client Services, and operational teams to develop accurate and competitive budgets, ensure contracts are completed efficiently, and maintain compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will manage multiple budgets and agreements simultaneously, support pricing and contract negotiations, identify and mitigate business risk, and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. The role requires strong analytical, financial, and contract management skills, with the ability to translate operational scope into commercially sound budgets and contractual terms.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Perform contract management tasks on medium complexity projects, as assigned.
  • Serve as contract management lead for strategic accounts, as assigned.
  • Independently develop and review Agreements including Master Services Agreements (Fortrea multi-unit, single unit Client or single unit Fortrea templates).
  • Lead negotiations for all assigned Agreements with moderate management support.
  • Develop and apply a working knowledge of the various Fortrea business units to insure proper contract terms for all types of studies.
  • Develop (including budgeting if required) and negotiate medium complexity Change Orders for assigned projects with management support.

  • Work cross-functionally with Contract Analysts, Client Services, Finance, Pricing and Sales to resolve contract issues in a timely manner.
  • Assist management and subject matter experts (SME) in maintaining harmonized contract processes and client relationships.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives intended to improve global delivery of contracts.
  • Adhere to Contract Management policies and process.
  • Ensure Sarbanes Oxley compliance from a contracting perspective.
  • Perform accurate data entry into SFDC, Apttus, CMS and/or other tools required for reporting.
  • Provide accurate updates on all outstanding contractual documents to management as required through required systems or tracking mechanisms.
  • Assist/mentor junior staff including providing pre-submission review and approval of junior staff’s signature documents in accordance with the Contract Management review guidelines, as assigned.
  • Participate in project review meetings, as necessary.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • BA or BS in business or life sciences (or equivalent experience).
  • Advanced English level

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Excellent customer service skills, attention to detail and ability to be persistent while maintaining tact.
  • Proven ability to work independently.
  • Experience and comfort in a high volume, fast paced environment is essential.
  • Ability to negotiate.

He is currently seeking to build out his support team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and a strong client experience. This role is crucial for enabling him to focus on high-value client relationships while communications, research, and travel logistics run seamlessly in the background.
Why does this role exist?
This role exists because the client is stretched across client-facing work, business development, and day-to-day operations, and is actively evaluating multiple paths — including other staffing options — to find the right long-term support. He's specifically looking for someone who combines excellent communication and sales instincts with genuine, hands-on AI-building skills, not just familiarity with popular tools. This is a high-bar hire: the client will only commit to a full-time role if the candidate is strong enough to operate proactively and strategically, without needing step-by-step direction.

Executive Administrative Support

Customer Sales Communication

Research Business Development

AI Automation Workflow Building

  • Strong communication skills with proven experience handling inbound and outbound customer/sales calls

Bilingual Patient Support Representative – English/Spanish | Healthcare | Remote LATAM

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Contractor
Location: LATAM
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)
Schedule: 40 Hours/Week

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Bilingual Patient Support Representative (English/Spanish) to provide compassionate, professional, and timely support to patients across the United States.

This is a highly patient-facing role where you’ll manage inbound calls, appointment scheduling, patient inquiries, follow-ups, and documentation in both English and Spanish.

You’ll be responsible for creating a positive patient experience from the first interaction onward—helping patients understand next steps, coordinating appointments, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring inquiries never fall through the cracks.

If you’re fluent in English and Spanish, communicate confidently over the phone, and have experience in customer service, healthcare support, medical scheduling, or other phone-based roles, this could be a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Patient Support & Communication

  • Support patients through:
    • Phone
    • SMS
    • Email
  • Respond promptly and professionally to new patient inquiries
  • Guide patients through consultation and scheduling processes
  • Communicate fluently in both English and Spanish
  • Answer patient questions and address concerns with empathy and professionalism
  • Follow established call flows while keeping conversations natural and engaging
  • Build trust and rapport during every patient interaction
  • Listen carefully to understand patient needs and determine appropriate next steps
  • Maintain professionalism during sensitive conversations

Appointment Scheduling & Follow-Up

  • Schedule consultations and appointments accurately
  • Collect and verify patient intake information
  • Track pending inquiries and required follow-ups
  • Ensure patient requests and inquiries are not overlooked
  • Coordinate with clinics and providers to support smooth scheduling
  • Keep patients informed about next steps throughout the process
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding inquiries
  • Maintain accurate appointment and follow-up information

Documentation & Systems Management

  • Accurately document patient interactions and outcomes
  • Maintain detailed and organized notes within company systems
  • Update patient information promptly and accurately
  • Navigate multiple systems while maintaining attention to detail
  • Keep patient records complete, organized, and current
  • Document follow-up requirements and outcomes
  • Maintain accuracy while moving between calls, messages, scheduling, and documentation

Quality & Team Collaboration

  • Participate in coaching and quality assurance reviews
  • Apply feedback to improve communication and patient experience
  • Collaborate with supervisors and team members on service improvements
  • Follow established workflows and quality standards
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and professionalism at all times
  • Take ownership of communication quality and patient satisfaction
  • Consistently follow established processes while maintaining a human, conversational approach

Requirements

  • Fluent English and Spanish, both spoken and written
  • Clear and easily understandable spoken English
  • Previous experience in one or more of the following:
    • Customer service
    • Patient support
    • Call center operations
    • Medical reception
    • Appointment scheduling
    • Other phone-based customer-facing roles
  • Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills
  • Strong emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally and empathetically
  • Experience accurately documenting customer or patient interactions
  • Comfortable learning and navigating multiple software systems
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple conversations, systems, and follow-ups
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Professional remote workspace
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) hours from LATAM

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous healthcare or medical customer service experience
  • Experience with:
    • Patient scheduling
    • Patient coordination
    • Medical reception
  • Familiarity with medical terminology
  • Experience using:
    • CRM systems
    • Scheduling platforms
    • Electronic Medical Records (EMRs)
  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based patients or customers

Tools & Technology

CRM Systems | Scheduling Platforms | Electronic Medical Records (EMRs) | Phone Systems | SMS | Email | Patient Communication & Documentation Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Speak English and Spanish fluently and confidently
  • Have clear, easily understandable spoken English
  • Communicate warmly and naturally over the phone
  • Enjoy helping patients and making complicated processes easier to understand
  • Are empathetic and comfortable handling sensitive conversations
  • Listen carefully and make patients feel heard
  • Can follow structured call flows without sounding scripted
  • Manage multiple conversations, systems, and follow-ups simultaneously
  • Are organized, dependable, and detail-oriented
  • Take coaching well and actively apply feedback
  • Maintain professionalism even during challenging conversations
  • Can build trust quickly with patients over the phone

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by responding to inbound patient calls and messages, helping new patients understand the consultation process, and scheduling appointments.

Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with patients in both English and Spanish, verify patient information, follow up on outstanding inquiries, and coordinate scheduling requirements with clinics and providers.

You’ll also update patient records, document conversations, manage follow-ups, and participate in coaching or quality reviews when needed.

In short: you help patients feel supported, informed, and cared for while ensuring appointments, follow-ups, and documentation are handled accurately.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Warm and professional patient interactions
  • Accurate appointment and consultation scheduling
  • Timely completion of patient follow-ups
  • Minimal missed or overlooked patient inquiries
  • Accurate and complete documentation
  • Strong patient rapport and communication quality
  • Consistent quality across English and Spanish interactions
  • Effective implementation of coaching and feedback
  • Consistent attendance, responsiveness, and reliability
  • High-quality patient experiences across phone, SMS, and email

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote contractor position
  • Stable 40-hour workweek
  • Paid lunch and daily break periods
  • Paid time off package
  • Major U.S. holidays off
  • Ongoing coaching and training
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Long-term growth opportunities within a growing healthcare organization

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct opportunity to positively impact the patient experience
  • Daily use of both English and Spanish
  • Exposure to U.S. healthcare and patient-support operations
  • Combination of communication, scheduling, coordination, and patient care
  • Structured coaching and professional development
  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates based in LATAM
  • Long-term career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Patient Support Representative
    • Patient Coordinator
    • Patient Support Team Lead
    • Healthcare Operations Coordinator
    • Patient Experience Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re fluent in English and Spanish, have experience in customer service, patient support, medical scheduling, healthcare support, or phone-based customer service, and genuinely enjoy helping people, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a growing healthcare organization where your communication, empathy, and attention to detail can directly improve the experience of patients across the United States.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Vaga Afirmativa para mulheres

No iFood, a promoção da Diversidade e da Inclusão faz parte da nossa Cultura, dentro do valor #AllTogether, e não se limita a um projeto específico ou temporário. E um dos nossos pilares é o compromisso com a promoção da equidade de gênero entre nossos(as) FoodLovers. Ao gerar oportunidades de inclusão, além de trazer talentos com diferentes perspectivas, opiniões e histórias, contribuímos ativamente para que haja representatividade e transformação na sociedade e na carreira de alguém. Afinal, aqui no iFood a gente dá match com nossas melhores versões.

Não realizamos nenhuma mudança de critério ou etapa no processo seletivo para essa vaga em comparação aos processos de vagas não exclusivas. Leia os critérios e requisitos abaixo e, se você se identificar com o perfil, será um prazer receber sua inscrição.

Nosso modo de fazer no time

Nosso objetivo é Alimentar o Futuro do Mundo, não só aplicando tecnologia de ponta, mas também por meio da Educação, Meio Ambiente e Inclusão.

Como Software Engineer, você irá projetar, codificar, testar serviços que impactam as principais áreas do iFood. Além disso, você também nos ajudará a construir estruturas e ferramentas para identificar gargalos de desempenho, medindo, monitorando e otimizando nosso desempenho, para garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e tolerância a falhas. Impactando diretamente a vida de milhões de pessoas diariamente!

Nesta posição, nós estamos trabalhando caminhos de oportunidades para vagas em diferentes setores como Backend e em todos os níveis de senioridade. Essa vaga funciona como um esteira contínua de recrutamento: quando você se inscrever, seu perfil será considerado para diferentes posições/ áreas que temos disponíveis e que se encaixem com suas habilidades e experiências profissionais. Se você der um match com a gente, ao final do processo seletivo, nós vamos te direcionar a uma vaga específica.

Seu Cardápio Diário

  • Design, código, testes, operar e resolver problemas de produção em serviços executados na nuvem (especialmente AWS);
  • Participação na priorização de evoluções no produto, levando em conta os melhores ganhos de valores para o negócio. Sempre baseando suas decisões em dados;
  • Construção de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Concepção e desenvolvimento de APIs;
  • Análise dos sistemas em produção buscando melhoria contínua.

Ingredientes que buscamos

  • Ser uma pessoa apaixonada por desenvolvimento de software orientado a objetos e programação funcional;
  • Testes automatizados, sistemas distribuídos e conceitos de segurança no desenvolvimento;
  • Bancos de dados relacional e NoSQL, queries e experiência com modelagem de dados;
  • Conhecimento no uso de filas e tópicos e comunicação assíncrona entre serviços (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ, … );
  • Interesse em programar com Java, Kotlin e/ou Rust;

raw.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
raw.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

Job Summary

The Transportation Consultant is responsible for supporting the data analysis, planning, optimization, and execution of transportation operations across the supply chain. This role focuses on the efficient movement of materials and finished products between distribution centers, warehouses, and end customers while driving improvements in service, cost, and operational performance.

As a transportation subject matter expert, the Transportation Consultant leverages data analysis, transportation systems, and industry best practices to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimize transportation networks, and implement solutions that enhance customer service and operational efficiency. The role partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to support strategic initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

The Transportation Consultant serves as a point of contact for internal operations teams and transportation providers, ensuring effective communication, issue resolution, and execution of transportation strategies. Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, project management experience, and the ability to influence stakeholders through data-driven recommendations that align with organizational objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Transportation Network Data Analytics and Reporting: Conduct comprehensive data analysis of the transportation network to identify opportunities for cost reduction, service improvements, and operational efficiencies, developing and maintaining performance dashboards, scorecards, and executive reports, and leveraging Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and other reporting tools to provide data-driven recommendations for network optimization and strategic execution.
  • Operational Improvement Project Management: Lead and manage transportation-related projects from conception to completion, focusing on driving operational efficiencies, cost reductions, and service enhancements. This includes defining project scope, objectives, timelines, and budgets.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between internal operations teams (e.g., supply chain, warehousing, sales) and external 3PL carriers, fostering strong relationships and ensuring alignment on transportation strategies and execution.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Reporting: Develop, monitor, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess fleet performance, identify trends, and pinpoint areas for improvement. Translate complex data into actionable insights and present findings to leadership.
  • Budget & Timeline Management: Effectively manage project budgets and timelines, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule and within financial parameters.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for process standardization and improvement within transportation operations, implementing best practices across the network.
  • Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve complex transportation challenges, leveraging data and collaborative problem-solving techniques.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration preferred
  • Preferred Certifications: PMP, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt
  • 4+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain management, with a focus on dedicated fleet operations or carrier management preferred
  • Proven experience in project management, including managing complex projects, timelines, and budgets.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with a strong ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, and derive actionable insights.
  • Proficiency with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Alteryx, and Power BI is highly beneficial.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with all levels of an organization and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational challenges.
  • Travel Expectations: 10-15%

Position Title

Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst Sr

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Senior Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst supports the Credit Risk Administration Team with the development, testing, implementation, monitoring, documentation, and maintenance of all credit risk rating models. Responsibilities include sourcing, cleaning, and transforming data; researching applicable methods; training and testing a variety of specifications; documenting all facets of the development process; implementation of models and related logic in production systems; assessing outputs across different levels of inputs (sensitivity analysis and scenario analysis); back-testing and ongoing performance monitoring; and, communicating aspects of the model and its application to non-technical stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and apply mathematical or statistical theory and methods to collect, organize, interpret, and summarize numerical data sets from multiple sources to develop credit risk rating models or other credit risk-related initiatives.
  • Derive model assumptions that are well reasoned and supportable.
  • Monitor the performance and calibration of existing models.
  • Implement models in code in a transparent and easily maintainable way within loan origination applications.
  • Comprehensively and clearly document all modeling or analysis work that meets internal, GAAP, and regulatory requirements; translate model theory and related results for non-quantitative audiences.
  • Develop and support strong controls for the model implementation framework and maintain related documentation.
  • Support independent model validation process, internal and external audits, and regulatory reviews.
  • Interact with model users, validators, and regulators to address model issues and remediation actions.
  • Interact with key stakeholder groups such as Accounting, Treasury, Credit, Lines of Business, Model Risk Management, and Enterprise Technology in the design, development, and ongoing usage of models.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with additional certifications or experience.
  • Minimum experience required: 6+ Years of model development, model performance monitoring or validation experience, particularly in credit risk.
  • Experience with at least one of the following software packages: R, SAS, SQL, Python.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics or related quantitative field.
  • Experience with commercial dual risk rating frameworks, especially in PD/LGD/EAD modeling approaches
  • Experience developing credit risk models and programing user interfaces.
  • Experience with nCino implementation of risk rating models and financial spreading process.
  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Basel III, Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing, CCAR, and bank accounting/regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Ability to use advanced statistical and mathematical software to perform descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analysis leveraging a variety of statistical techniques (such as segmentation, logistic regression, sensitivity analysis, and machine learning).

Job Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to clearly articulate, in writing or orally, ideas, analytic insights, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including an executive audience.
  • An ability to identify key problems, conduct in-depth research, and articulate well-reasoned solutions.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
  • Travel is not required for this role.
  • Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters, patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans and processing over 13 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Account Management Services, the Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a liaison between Availity’s technical teams, health plan analyst, Strategic Account Managers (SAS) and the strategic health plan partners, ensuring that the products or services align with the customers' technical needs and business objectives. TAMs are responsible for ensuring customer success by proactively building, maintaining, and expanding relationships with our strategic Payer Partners to advance the direction of Availity in the healthcare information technology marketplace. TAMs will focus on becoming a Trusted Advisor to the clients, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage timelines, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. TAMs will provide exceptional customer service and support to build strong, long-term relationships with clients. Providing thought leadership and delivering account management excellence. The TAM is an expert on their book of business and represents the voice of the customer internally and the interests of the organization externally. The TAM is an expert communicator and relationship builder that implements key marketing strategies to enhance the company's position. Some travel is required.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Why do you want to work for this team:

  • This is a fast-paced, flexible, and collaborative work environment where you are encouraged to bring your authentic self every day in the pursuit of serving our clients.

  • This position gives exposure to multiple areas within Availity and is a great career path to future Account Management roles within the company.

To be qualified for this role you:

  • Have at least 3 years of account OR customer management experience in healthcare, payer, provider relations, or technology environment.

  • Have an associate degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or equivalent work experience, bachelor’s degree a plus.

  • Have strong interpersonal skills. Experience facilitating meetings and engaging with multiple stakeholders at all levels of the organization is vital.

  • Team player that works in support of others and in close collaborative partnership.

  • Have knowledge of healthcare payer processing, provider/hospital office operations, customer service and IT operations.

  • Are a trusted problem-solver who listens to business problems and can provide potential solutions.

  • Interpret technical issues and translate them into actionable business impacts for executive and operational audiences.

  • You have exceptional customer service skills.

  • Have strong analytical and research skills with ability to guide client based on analytical data.

  • Monthly monitoring, and creation of SLA adherence and process improvement based on output.

  • Leveraging data to identify opportunities for operational improvement, payer adoption growth, and issue prevention.

  • Highly motivated, self-starting, and proactive – not reactive. Maintain awareness of all active implementations, production support efforts, strategic programs, and roadmap initiatives impacting assigned accounts.

  • Identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and competing priorities that may impact client outcomes.

  • Ability to see the bigger picture and have demonstrated ability to use discretion and make sound decisions.

  • Have HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) knowledge.

  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to remain collaborative within high stakes environments (ability to remain calm during internal/external escalations)

What will set you apart:

  • Serve as the primary operational escalation point for strategic payer partners, coordinating cross-functional resources through solutioning or issue resolution.

  • You thrive in a rapidly changing and highly ambiguous environment.

  • Can effectively manage complex projects end-to-end ensuring high levels of satisfaction and execution.

  • Have knowledge of technical systems integration and internal operating systems e.g. Salesforce, Jira, Gainsight, Confluence.

  • Experience with a large national payer with complex operational, implementation, escalation, and governance needs across multiple business units and technical platforms.

What you will be doing:

  • Supporting the relationship between complex assigned accounts and Availity, and acts as a point of contact for accountability, issue escalation/resolution, and product implementations.

  • Supporting aspects of the re-contracting process including pricing, proposal, administration functions, preparation for negotiations and customer presentations.

  • Obtaining, utilizing, and accurately summarizing key competitive data to affect positive account growth.

  • Working with cross functional teams to coordinate and implement new functionality for assigned payers.

  • Staying current on industry and competitive trends and applies knowledge of marketplace to account planning processes.

  • Identifying and coordinating marketing, management, and technical resources necessary to achieve existing account up-sell objectives.

  • Communicating with accounts on a regular basis based on tier structure and need, via newsletters, email, phone, and/or face to face meetings.

  • Consults with Health Plan customers to identify and qualify opportunities to up-sell new products or services

  • Monitoring and supports retention through volume analysis and account penetration.

  • Reporting regularly on the progress and accomplishment of stated goals by updating metrics that track results.

  • Building strong inter-departmental relationships to achieve individual and Account Management team objectives.

  • Establishing, maintaining, and updating Relationship Account Plans with all assigned accounts.

Availity culture and benefits:

Availity is a certified "Great Place to Work," "Best Workplaces for Technology Companies," "Best Workplaces for Women," and "Best Workplaces for Millennials!"

Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!

We have several Diversity & Inclusion teams and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates. "AvaiLadies," "Beyond Black," "HOLA," "Availity Pride," "VetAvaility," Young Professionals Group, and "She Can Code IT" are just some of the communities you can get involved in.

As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. Position: Learning Manager
