About LRN:

LRN is the world’s leading dedicated ethics and compliance SaaS company, helping more than 30 million people every year navigate complex regional and global regulatory environments and build ethical, responsible cultures. With over 3,000 clients across the US, EMEA, APAC, and Latin America—including some of the world’s most respected and successful brands—we’re proud to be the long-term partner trusted to reduce organizational risk and drive principled performance.

Named one of Inc Magazine’s 5000 Fastest-Growing Companies, LRN is redefining how organizations turn values into action. Our state-of-the-art platform combines intuitive design, mobile accessibility, robust analytics, and industry benchmarking—enabling organizations to create, manage, deliver, and audit ethics and compliance programs with confidence. Backed by a unique blend of technology, education, and expert advisement, LRN helps companies turn their values into real-world behaviors and leadership practices that deliver lasting competitive advantage.

About the role:

As a Learning Manager, you will be designing training solutions for our clients. You will be engaging with the clients to understand their business needs. You will attend Design Workshops where you will deliver exciting ideas that will have the greatest impact on the learners; e-learning course, an interactive workbook, a game, an animated sequence, – or a combination of ALL these things. You will guide a team of Instructional Designers through the project to ensure that training solutions are creative, captivating, modern and will create a measurable change in the organization. Supporting our Delivery team on an ad-hoc basis.

Requirements

What you'll do:

  • Leading Instructional Designers and subject matter experts across the content team to develop e-learning course content
  • Analysing, designing, developing, implementing and evaluating online learning and support solutions based on the client requirements using different digital media appropriate to their needs
  • Working with Instructional Designers on instructional, graphic and assessment design across multiple learning project workflows simultaneously, within stipulated standards, resources, and deadlines
  • Responsible for strong versatile creative writing skills and guides the team to write for e-learning, animations, drama, printed materials etc
  • Developing templates, organize, manage, and repurpose course content files (audio, video, SCORM), schedule periodic course reviews, and track documentation and version control in order to manage content creation and the effective organization of digital and digitized information.
  • Responsible to run a creative meeting and keep it on-track
  • Responsible for multiple delivery methods (HTML5, Storyline, Articulate Rise, PDF, Word, PPT)

What we're looking for:

  • A minimum of 4 years' experience in Instructional Design
  • BA or equivalent experience
  • Experience of Creative Writing
  • Has strong views about how best to communicate information to a diverse audience.
  • Has an eye for good visual design

Benefits

  • Competitive hourly rates

LRN is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

raw.excerpt: About Shift MarketsShift Markets began in the world of traditional finance as a pioneer in FX technology.
raw.description:
About Shift Markets

Shift Markets began in the world of traditional finance as a pioneer in FX technology. Recognizing the transformative potential of digital assets early on, we set out to bridge the gap between traditional markets and crypto, making digital asset trading accessible to businesses of all sizes, from emerging brokerages to global institutions.

We are a global team with a shared mission to innovate in crypto infrastructure. Whether collaborating in office or connecting remotely, we work together as one to move finance forward. We believe collaboration fuels creativity, diversity drives strength, and curiosity keeps us ahead of the curve.

Every great company is built by great people. Join us to help shape the future of digital asset infrastructure.

About the Role

We're hiring a Growth Marketing Associate to drive top-of-funnel for our prediction-markets and crypto-exchange-infrastructure business.

You’ll serve as Shift’s remote prediction-markets industry connector, helping us track market developments, build relationships across relevant online communities, identify commercial opportunities, and strengthen Shift’s credibility within the prediction-markets ecosystem. Day to day, you’ll contribute industry insights and content, build AI-enabled research workflows, and work with our Sales and Partnerships teams to turn market signals and relationships into opportunities.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Contribute prediction-market insights, commentary, and industry-led content in collaboration with Shift’s Content & Social Media Marketer. Help ensure Shift’s content reflects current market conversations, trends, and developments.

  • Engage with relevant online communities and industry conversations across X, Reddit, newsletters, forums, and other digital channels to build relationships and identify useful market signals.

  • Build and operate advanced AI-enabled workflows for prediction-market research, competitor monitoring, market intelligence, content ideation, and prospect discovery. Connect tools and data sources to create repeatable workflows rather than using AI solely for basic drafting.

  • Run email nurture campaigns through Klaviyo for our prediction-markets lane.

  • Identify potential prospects, partners, and commercial opportunities through online research, community engagement, and market monitoring, and route relevant opportunities to the Sales and Partnerships teams.

  • Monitor prediction-market, crypto, trading, competitor, regulatory, and key-opinion-leader activity, and translate relevant developments into concise briefs and recommendations the team can act on.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience, or equivalent evidence of meaningful involvement in prediction markets, crypto, trading, growth, content, business development, research, or related online communities.

  • Advanced practical fluency with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent platforms. You must be able to demonstrate at least one substantive workflow, automation, agent, research system, or other project you have built and shipped using these tools.

  • A public writing voice. Send us your X, Substack, Reddit, blog, GitHub, or anywhere else you ship. Followers don't matter; voice does.

  • Evidence of active industry participation, such as public research, social commentary, community involvement, relevant personal projects, trading activity, newsletters, videos, or an existing online network within prediction markets, crypto, or trading.

  • Real curiosity about prediction markets, crypto, and the future of trading infrastructure. You don't need a finance degree, but you should be able to explain what a prediction market is and why it matters in two sentences.

Bonus Points

  • Crypto-native. You've used a wallet, you follow CT, and you can explain who our competitors are.

  • Relevant experience in marketing, content, research, business development, partnerships, or growth within crypto, fintech, trading, marketplaces, or another technology sector.

  • You've built and shipped something publicly. An agent, an app, a content series, a newsletter.

  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, Apollo, or similar GTM tooling.

Why join Shift?

  • Build the brand for a new market. Prediction markets is being defined right now, and you help set how Shift shows up in it.

  • Real leverage. You automate the repetitive work and spend your time on ideas.

  • Direct access. Small team, no layers. You work next to senior operators.

  • Real ownership, fast cycles, and a clear runway to senior responsibility.

This is a remote, 40-hour-per-week role. Compensation will be based on skills, experience, and location.
